audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Record security-relevant events for your vaults on this device.

enabled.label: Enable audit logging
enabled.description: When off, no new events are written. Your existing log file is preserved.

retentionDays.label: Retention (days)
retentionDays.description: How long to keep audit events. Valid range: 1 to 365 days. Cleanup of older events is not enforced yet.
retentionDays.validation: Retention must be between 1 and 365 days.

backups.title: Backups
backups.description: Automatic snapshots of your vault file before every save.

enabled.label: Enable backups
enabled.description: Before saving, copy the previous vault bytes into a .kdbx-backups/ folder next to the file.

maxVersions.label: Keep N backups
maxVersions.description: Older snapshots beyond this count are deleted after each successful save.

error.failed: Backup failed for {{path}}: {{reason}}. The vault was not saved.

warning.openSide: Open-side backup failed for {{path}}: {{reason}}. The vault is still unlocked.

onOpen.label: Back up on open
onOpen.description: Also take a snapshot whenever a vault successfully unlocks. Identical-content opens are silently skipped.

keyfile.label: Schlüsseldatei (Optional)
